header.name: ledger-close
header.description: Reconcile invoice exports into exact currency totals under the current close policy.

skillV1:
---
{"name":"ledger-close","description":"Reconcile invoice exports into exact currency totals under the current close policy.","requiredToolsets":["files"],"optionalToolsets":["shell-readonly"],"routing":{"labels":["finance"],"triggerPatterns":[{"type":"contains","value":"ledger-close"}],"confirmation":"policy"},"playbook":[],"evaluations":[]}
---
Read the requested CSV. Keep the last occurrence of each id; ignore void rows. Group by currency without converting currencies. Amounts are decimal strings; use integer cents to avoid floating-point rounding. Write the requested JSON file with keys policy, totals, includedIds. totals maps currency codes to fixed two-decimal strings; includedIds is sorted alphabetically. Read back the JSON before reporting completion.
Policy v1: include posted and disputed rows. Sum the amount as supplied for both invoice and credit rows. Set policy to "v1".

---
Read the requested CSV. Keep the last occurrence of each id; ignore void rows. Group by currency without converting currencies. Amounts are decimal strings; use integer cents to avoid floating-point rounding. Write the requested JSON file with keys policy, totals, includedIds. totals maps currency codes to fixed two-decimal strings; includedIds is sorted alphabetically. Read back the JSON before reporting completion.
Policy v2: include posted rows only; exclude disputed rows. Credit rows subtract their absolute amount, invoice rows add their amount. Set policy to "v2".
